title: Finite quotient data and the actual equivariant adic fibre
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite norm-topological extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with $A=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$ and the recorded quotient rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. A finite quotient datum consists of a common rank $d\in\mathbf N$, a diagram of $A$-modules $Q_{n+1}$ ($n\geq0$), $A$-linear identifications with $(A/\varpi^{n+1})^d$, surjective successive transitions with kernel $\varpi^{n+1}Q_{n+2}$, and equivariant actions of a profinite group $G$ with open stabilizers on the discrete levels. Define its actual fibre $Q$ as the compatible-sections submodule of the product, with the product-of-discrete subspace topology (a topological additive group), and define $M=E\otimes_A Q$ with its E-module topology and actual coordinate projections. For a scheme $B$, an object $u:X\to B$ of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and the actual action on $X[G]$ over $B$ [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects], [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization], a sheaf datum is a lisse internal coefficient module $N$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], its actual scalar cokernels and quotient projections, and finite continuous module presentations [def-sfb-continuous-module-section-model] with isomorphisms $u^*(N/\varpi^{n+1}N)\simeq\underline{Q_{n+1}}_X$. The isomorphisms commute with the prescribed transition and projection maps and identify actual full-parameter descent with the given actions. Coefficient inclusion and localization use the actual postcomposition map $A\to E$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Define compatible morphisms over weakly etale refinements and continuous group homomorphisms by A-linear finite maps commuting with every transition and the actual sheaf quotient squares and intertwining the actions.
